core.headline: New three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill
core.listing:
A new three-bedroom semi-detached house (The Larch) on Orchard Rise in Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. The house has a 10-year NHBC warranty and two allocated parking spaces with an EV charging point.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"), both with underfloor heating powered by an air source heat pump. The first floor has three bedrooms including a principal bedroom 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, plus a family bathroom. The first floor has radiator heating.

Outside there is a turfed rear garden with a patio.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away.

Fixed Price £410,000 for the freehold. A reservation fee of £1,500 is payable, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026. Estate charge £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: standard – brick and block under a tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage. Broadband: FTTP. No onward chain. The final EPC will be issued on completion.
core.summary: New three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill, West Malling, with completion expected spring 2027. Air source heat pump, underfloor heating downstairs, EV charging point, two allocated spaces and 10-year NHBC warranty.

Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring (by 30 November 2026)
